items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure, go-live, and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown, not certification. Risk severity is high for public launch and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates; continue only existing read-only evidence work; allow ordinary reversible changes only when they add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim certification or a clean security status.

Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, incident response readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
